Identifying the wrong dish led the subsequent agents to search for recommendations for a breakfast burrito rather than the correct dish (Green Chili Stew), which is the primary reason the specific book title was not found. The search results actually confirm Frontier is famous for "Green Chili Stew," not specifically highlighted for breakfast burritos in this context.
